title_lines: an AI workbench of their own.
hero.lead: General AI tools solve common problems. YourBuddy brings your preferred models, Skills, Plugins, files, and professional workflows into one desktop workbench that grows around the way you work.

example.title: Your workbench starts with one small task.
example.desc: Example task: write a plan in your workspace, then open the file to review it.

items.title: Try asking
items.desc: Create hello-yourbuddy.md in the current directory with three tasks for this week and an acceptance criterion for each. Tell me where you saved it.

items.title: Choose a model and folder
items.desc: Connect an available account or API and select a practice folder.

items.title: Give YourBuddy the task
items.desc: Send your request and respond to any approval prompts in the app.

items.title: Open the file and check it
items.desc: Read the result in the file panel. In a Git repository, you can also review the diff.

workflow.title: Grow a general foundation into your workbench.

items.title: Choose your models
items.desc: Connect an account or provider and switch models for each task. Your workbench is not tied to one model.

items.title: Bring in your methods
items.desc: Use Skills for repeatable workflows and standards. Use Plugins to add tools, services, and workbench interfaces.

items.title: Keep the whole job in view
items.desc: Use files, the editor, terminal, Git, and plugin pages beside the conversation, and inspect the actual result at any time.

cta.title: Start with work that is actually yours.
cta.desc: Open a familiar folder and choose a model. After the first task, turn repeatable methods into Skills and specialized capabilities into Plugins.

plugins.title: Do more than install plugins. Shape the workbench.
plugins.desc: Skills teach the workbench your workflows. Plugins add tools, services, and workbench interfaces. YourBuddy provides a useful foundation that each person can extend around their profession and habits.

items.title: Codex Auth
items.desc: Connect an existing account for models, search, and image capabilities with less repeated setup.

items.title: Better Sidebar
items.desc: Use files, the editor, terminal, Git, previews, and plugin pages in the primary workbench beside the conversation.

items.title: Context Doctor
items.desc: Inspect context usage, duplicate content, and shadowed skills to help diagnose session issues.

items.title: Plugin Marketplace
items.desc: Explore available extensions and their sources before adding the tools you need.

items.title: Harbor Evolution
items.desc: An independent project developed by the Y8 maintainer for evidence-based diagnosis and controlled evaluation.
